UI_ApocBR_Server_One_Description:
The main server of the Apocalipse BR community, where most of our survivors gather.

-> A cooperative survival and faction warfare server.
Largest player population in the community.
Balanced survival experience.
-> Safehouse claiming after 2 days of survival.
UI_ApocBR_Server_Two_Description:
An experience designed for seasoned survivors, featuring a high concentration of Sprinters.
Even a simple supply run can turn into a desperate fight for survival.

-> Earn money by eliminating infected and exchange it for points.
-> Safehouse claiming only after 60 days of survival.
-> High-difficulty survival experience.
UI_ApocBR_Server_Extraction_Description:
A new gameplay experience within the Apocalipse BR universe, currently under development, focused on mercenary operations, strategic incursions, and extraction missions.
Without the protection of Safehouses, the experience focuses on mobility, operational execution, and successful extraction.

-> Server currently under development.
-> Water-based map designed for extraction operations.
-> Gameplay focused on mercenary operations.
-> No Safehouse claiming system.
